Because the orchard burn is recorded at the lotus settlement, the lantern audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 84% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 288 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
